items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: And when I went to the Blue Room two years ago, Sophie Tuckett was there.

ctx.x: They make too many solos and all that.

Yeah, and they, I know, uh, Carnival Day, I went in more, more of them, they were letting everybody go in, and all they were doing was some kind of swing dancing. I went in the Court of Two Sisters. I went in, I don't know how many nightclubs that were open. All they were doing was swinging back and forth, something similar to what the teenagers are doing. And when I went to the Blue Room two years ago, Sophie Tuckett was there. I went to the Blue Room and they wasn't doing any jazz dancing in the Blue Room at…
Well, uh, I'm surprised though that you didn't go into the French Quarter or any. You didn't go down for coffee and donuts or anything like that.
